proof: For each retained row i, let phi_i be its dihedral-orbit average of the even-parity character (-1)^|I intersect T|. Then ||phi_i||_infinity <= 1 and E_{w_R} phi_i is the corresponding principal-minor moment. With exact row scale s_i, define G(T)=sum_i z_i phi_i(T)/s_i. Its sup norm is at most M=sum_i |z_i|/s_i. The Arb-certified dual gives E_u G - E_{w_p} G > objective-slack for every mixture p on the exact 201-column pool. By the TV dual inequality, TV(w_p,u) > (objective-slack)/(2M).
scope: One selected parity sector and arbitrary probability mixtures over exactly the 201 certified physical columns. The conclusion is for the balanced program-label mass distribution (equivalently the dephased label-register trace distance), not a Choi-state or channel diamond-distance lower bound. The 645 sixth-order rows and seven eighth-order rows are selected/cut inventories, not complete orbit systems.
